module: Node "Color" (provider). Provides a color (RGBA table {r,g,b,a}, with 4 extra PBR values at indices 5-8 in custom mode) on the color pin. Modes: 'custom' (picker in the editor) or 'from Pin' (pins r, g, b, a of type number).
notes: In 'from Pin' mode, the output is {r,g,b,a} without the PBR values.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Mode choice, creation/deletion of the r/g/b/a pins and color picker (editor.uiColorEdit8).

_onSerialize.desc: Saves the node's state in the given table.

_onDeserialized.desc: Restores clr (padded to 8 values) and mode.

work.desc: Writes the color (from the pins in 'from Pin' mode, otherwise clr).

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the central content of the node in the editor.

createColorPins.desc: Creates the number input pins r, g, b, a.
